name: Too-Ashuu Pass
near: From the north — Sosnovka (toll checkpoint, ~2 h from Bishkek) in the Kara-Balta valley; from the south — the villages of the Suusamyr Valley (Kaysar — ~16 km as the crow flies, OSM). At the southern portal of the tunnel is the Too-Ashuu ski base.
elev: The pass — 3586 m (2GIS, asiamixtravel); the old gravel road over the saddle climbed to ~3594 m (dangerousroads). The K. Kolbaev Tunnel is at ~3120–3180 m (asiamixtravel, dangerousroads); the ski base is at about 3000 m.
short: Too-Ashuu (Töö-Ashuu, “Camel Pass”) is a 3586 m pass through the Kyrgyz Range on the Bishkek — Osh highway; vehicles go through it by a tunnel ~2.7 km long at an altitude of ~3150 m and descend by switchbacks into Suusamyr.
desc: Too-Ashuu is one of the two road crossings of the Kyrgyz Range connecting the Chuy Valley with the Suusamyr Valley (2GIS). The saddle of the pass is at 3586 m; in the 1960s a tunnel about 2.7 km long was bored under it at an altitude of ~3120–3180 m (now the K. Kolbaev Tunnel), replacing the dangerous gravel road over the top (dangerousroads, asiamixtravel). From the north, switchbacks lead to the tunnel from the Kara-Balta gorge, and from the south there is a descent to Suusamyr. The name translates as “camel pass”. The tunnel is narrow and poorly ventilated; in 2001 a carbon monoxide poisoning tragedy occurred in it. A fee is charged for passing through the tunnels of the Bishkek — Osh highway at the Sosnovka and Kara-Kol checkpoints. At the southern portal, the highest ski base in Central Asia, Too-Ashuu (~3000 m), has operated since 2009–2010. The construction of a new long tunnel under the pass is being discussed at government level.
guide: Too-Ashuu is the first real “3000+” on the way from Bishkek to Osh. Before the tunnel, on the northern switchbacks, there are viewing platforms overlooking the Kara-Balta valley — stop only at the road's wider spots. In the tunnel itself (about 2.7 km) turn on your headlights, close the windows and set the ventilation to recirculation — it is narrow and smoky. Right after you exit, the Suusamyr Valley opens up — one of the most spectacular views on the highway. In winter check the Ministry of Transport bulletins: restrictions are introduced here during snowfalls.
see: The switchbacks of the northern slope and the view of the Kara-Balta valley; the K. Kolbaev Tunnel (~2.7 km, ~3150 m); the panorama of the Suusamyr Valley after the tunnel; the Too-Ashuu ski base at the southern portal; the old road to the 3586 m saddle (dangerous out of season).
skip: You aren't going to Suusamyr, Talas or Osh — in summer there is little point in driving 2–2.5 h from Bishkek just for the pass. You tolerate switchbacks and altitude above 3000 m poorly. You're driving in winter without winter tires — dangerous.
diff: For a passenger — no effort. For the driver — serious mountain switchbacks and a narrow, poorly ventilated tunnel at ~3150 m; in winter — snow, black ice, avalanche danger. On foot to the 3586 m saddle along the old road — only for the acclimatized; the sources do not describe a route.
when: June — September: dry road and a green Suusamyr. The highway is open year-round, but from November to April there is snow and temporary restrictions (for example, on 11–13.02.2026 truck traffic was restricted because of snowfall — 24.kg). The ski season at the Too-Ashuu base is from late November to March/April.
hours: The Bishkek — Osh highway and the tunnel operate around the clock, except for temporary closures: repairs (for example, 26.07–06.08.2023 — daily 06:00–16:00 for passenger cars, Kyrtag), snowfalls and avalanches (Ministry of Transport). Check the Ministry of Transport/24.kg bulletins before you travel.
daytime: In the daytime, in daylight: the best views are on the switchbacks and in Suusamyr, and there is less risk of black ice. Avoid driving at night in winter.
how: From Bishkek along the Bishkek — Osh highway west to Kara-Balta, then south along the gorge via Sosnovka (toll checkpoint) and the switchbacks to the tunnel (~130 km to the pass, 2–2.5 h — asiamixtravel). The modern road goes through the tunnel, not over the upper saddle.
needcar: Yes: your own car, a taxi or intercity transport Bishkek — Osh/Suusamyr/Talas. A public transport stop at the viewpoints is not guaranteed.
self: Yes, by your own car or taxi. In winter — only on winter tires and after checking the bulletins. A walk to the saddle — there are no sources, so it cannot be recommended.
roadtype: The paved Bishkek — Osh trunk road (M41) with mountain switchbacks; the ~2.7 km tunnel is narrow, and its asphalt was renewed in summer 2023 (Kyrtag). The old road over the upper 3586 m saddle is gravel, its condition is not confirmed.
traveltime: Bishkek → Too-Ashuu tunnel/base: ~130 km, 2–2.5 h (asiamixtravel); to the Sosnovka checkpoint ~2 h (TollGuru). Passing through the tunnel takes a few minutes.
stay: The Too-Ashuu ski base at the southern portal: a guesthouse with 66 beds plus cottages and cabins, ~100 beds in total; a cafe-bar, sauna, rental (asiamixtravel, 2026; prices not stated). In summer — yurt camps and guesthouses in the Suusamyr Valley.
net: Too.kg notes incomplete coverage on the pass section; in the tunnel the signal may drop out. The operator is not specified.
entry: No entry fee. Toll for passing through the tunnels of the Bishkek — Osh highway: 50 som for a car (Kyrgyz plates), 200 som — foreign plates; buses 100/1000 som (since 01.01.2024; Kaktus.media). Payment at the Sosnovka/Kara-Kol checkpoints.
transfer: Shared taxi Bishkek — Osh 2500 som/seat (2025–2026, asocialnomad); tunnel toll 50 som/car. Transfers to the ski base — by arrangement, prices not confirmed.
bring: A warm jacket even in summer (at ~3150 m it is cool and windy), sunglasses, water and a snack (there are few services on the switchbacks), cash or an app to pay the toll. In winter — chains/studs, a reserve of fuel, a shovel.
warn: The tunnel is narrow and poorly ventilated: thick exhaust, visibility drops — turn on your headlights, keep your distance, do not stop inside (dangerousroads; in 2001 people died from carbon monoxide during a traffic jam). In winter — snow, black ice, avalanches, temporary bans for trucks (24.kg 13.02.2026). At ~3150–3586 m altitude — altitude sickness is possible when stopping. Periodic closures of the tunnel for repairs.
food: The cafe-bar of the Too-Ashuu ski base (asiamixtravel); in summer on the road in Suusamyr — kumis and Kyrgyz cuisine at yurts along the highway (per too.kg for Suusamyr). Specific places at the pass itself are not confirmed.
reviews: Google Maps (Pereval Teo-Ashuu): 4.8/5, 94 ratings (03.10.2026); 2GIS: 4.7/5, 30 ratings, 14 reviews (07.10.2026); TripAdvisor: the “Too-Ashu Pass” page (d10112269). Pros: spectacular switchbacks, views of Suusamyr, “high and beautiful”. Cons: a smoky narrow tunnel, dangerous in winter.
p.sum: Too-Ashuu (3586 m; the Kolbaev Tunnel at ~3150 m) is the gateway of the Bishkek — Osh highway between the Kara-Balta valley and Suusamyr, ≈130 km and 2–2.5 h from Bishkek. The pass is driven through on the way: by your own car (tunnel toll 50 som for Kyrgyz plates and 200 som for foreign ones, at the Sosnovka/Kara-Kol checkpoints), by shared taxi Bishkek — Osh (2500 som per seat) or by marshrutka (minibus) to Osh/Talas/Suusamyr. You can stop at the ski base at the southern portal: ski pass 1000/800 som, cottages for 66 guests. In 2026 the asphalt and parapets were replaced at km 130–146, and by October the approaches to the portals were repaired — restrictions are possible in summer. In winter, check the Ministry of Transport bulletins before the trip, and in the tunnel keep your distance, turn on your headlights and do not stop.
p.apps.0.title: From the north from Bishkek via Kara-Balta and Sosnovka
p.apps.0.route: Bishkek → M41 highway west → Kara-Balta → turn south → Sosnovka (toll checkpoint) → Kara-Balta gorge → switchbacks → northern portal of the Kolbaev Tunnel (~3150 m) → southern portal, ski base
p.apps.0.surface: Paved trunk road with switchbacks; the ~2.7 km tunnel is narrow and poorly ventilated. In 2026: replacement of asphalt and parapets at km 130–146 (summer) and repair of 1 km of the portal approaches (540 m from the north, 460 m from the south, 370 m of sidewalks, 44 lamps — completed by 02.10.2026)
p.apps.0.season: Year-round; November — April: snow, avalanches, temporary truck bans (11–13.02.2026)
p.apps.0.last: The last large fuel stations, ATMs and supermarkets — Kara-Balta; in Sosnovka — roadside cafes and the toll checkpoint. Few services on the switchbacks. Mobile signal on the pass section is incomplete and drops out in the tunnel
p.apps.0.parking.d: Areas at the portals and at the ski base on the southern side; do not stop right at the tunnel
p.apps.0.trail.d: The sources do not describe walking routes to the 3586 m saddle along the old gravel road
p.apps.0.haz: Carbon monoxide and poor visibility in the tunnel during traffic jams (there were casualties in 2001); avalanches and black ice in winter; altitude sickness during long stops at 3000+ m; roadworks in summer 2026

p.iti.2.title: What to combine
p.iti.2.plan: The Suusamyr Valley (yurts, kumis), the Kojomkul museum and mazar, Western Karakol (via Suusamyr), the Belogorka waterfall (a detour via Sokuluk)
p.season: June — September: dry road, green Suusamyr, in summer 2026 — roadworks (km 130–146). October — November: first snowfalls. November — March/April: ski season, snow, avalanches, restrictions for trucks, traffic jams in the tunnel are possible
p.budget.economy: Marshrutka (minibus)/per-seat taxi to Suusamyr (price not found; Bishkek — Osh 800–2500 som) + lunch 300–500 som
p.budget.comfort: Own/rental car ($20–100/day) + toll 50/200 som + fuel; Tripster tour €384 per group; in winter — ski pass 1000 som, rental 400–600 som, cottage from 4000 som
p.permits: No permit needed. Only passage through the tunnels of the Bishkek — Osh highway is paid: 50 som (Kyrgyz passenger cars) / 200 som (foreign plates), since 01.01.2024
p.access: As a stop from the car — accessible to everyone; an altitude of 3000+ m may be hard for older people and people with heart conditions (do not linger). Stroller — only on the base's platforms. With a dog — no restrictions
